bio: Research Overview Research Background Education Publications Contact Us Dr. David Harris has participated in developing a better understanding of a number of genetic disorders. He is part of the Developmental Anatomy Project (PI: Cynthia Morton, PhD) that has been identifying genes through the device of interruptions through balanced chromosome rearrangements.
